shortDescription: Configuration for Policy Based Routing(PBR) entry resource.

options.name: action
options.description: Action to perform on the outgoing IPv4 packets that match the PBR.  Available settings function as follows: * C(ALLOW) - The Citrix ADC sends the packet to the designated next-hop router. * C(DENY) - The Citrix ADC applies the routing table for normal destination-based routing.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: destip
options.description: IP address or range of IP addresses to match against the destination IP address of an outgoing IPv4 packet.  In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 10.102.29.30-10.102.29.189.

options.name: destipop
options.description: Either the equals (=) or does not equal (!=) logical operator.

options.name: destipval
options.description: IP address or range of IP addresses to match against the destination IP address of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 10.102.29.30-10.102.29.189.

options.name: destport
options.description: Port number or range of port numbers to match against the destination port number of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 40-90.  Note: The destination port can be specified only for TCP and UDP protocols.

options.name: destportop
options.description: Either the equals (=) or does not equal (!=) logical operator.

options.name: destportval
options.description: Port number or range of port numbers to match against the destination port number of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 40-90.  Note: The destination port can be specified only for TCP and UDP protocols.

options.name: detail
options.description: To get a detailed view.

options.name: interface
options.description: ID of an interface. The Citrix ADC compares the PBR only to the outgoing packets on the specified interface. If you do not specify any value, the appliance compares the PBR to the outgoing packets on all interfaces.

options.name: iptunnel
options.description: The Tunnel name.

options.name: iptunnelname
options.description: The iptunnel name where packets need to be forwarded upon.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: monitor
options.description: The name of the monitor.(Can be only of type ping or ARP )

options.name: msr
options.description: Monitor the route specified byte Next Hop parameter. This parameter is not applicable if you specify a link load balancing (LLB) virtual server name with the Next Hop parameter.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the PBR. Must begin with an ASCII alphabetic or underscore \(_\) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash \(\#\), period \(.\), space, colon \(:\), at \(@\), equals \(=\), and hyphen \(-\) characters. Cannot be changed after the PBR is created.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nexthop
options.description: IP address of the next hop router or the name of the link load balancing virtual server to which to send matching packets if action is set to ALLOW. If you specify a link load balancing (LLB) virtual server, which can provide a backup if a next hop link fails, first make sure that the next hops bound to the LLB virtual server are actually next hops that are directly connected to the Citrix ADC. Otherwise, the Citrix ADC throws an error when you attempt to create the PBR. The next hop can be null

options.name: nexthopval
options.description: The Next Hop IP address or gateway name.

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ownergroup
options.description: The owner node group in a Cluster for this pbr rule. If ownernode is not specified then the pbr rule is treated as Striped pbr rule.

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of the PBR, which determines the order in which it is evaluated relative to the other PBRs. If you do not specify priorities while creating PBRs, the PBRs are evaluated in the order in which they are created.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol, identified by protocol name, to match against the protocol of an outgoing IPv4 packet.

options.name: protocolnumber
options.description: Protocol, identified by protocol number, to match against the protocol of an outgoing IPv4 packet.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: srcip
options.description: IP address or range of IP addresses to match against the source IP address of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 10.102.29.30-10.102.29.189.

options.name: srcipop
options.description: Either the equals (=) or does not equal (!=) logical operator.

options.name: srcipval
options.description: IP address or range of IP addresses to match against the source IP address of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 10.102.29.30-10.102.29.189.

options.name: srcmac
options.description: MAC address to match against the source MAC address of an outgoing IPv4 packet.

options.name: srcmacmask
options.description: Used to define range of Source MAC address. It takes string of 0 and 1, 0s are for exact match and 1s for wildcard. For matching first 3 bytes of MAC address, srcMacMask value "000000111111".

options.name: srcport
options.description: Port number or range of port numbers to match against the source port number of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 40-90.  Note: The destination port can be specified only for TCP and UDP protocols.

options.name: srcportop
options.description: Either the equals (=) or does not equal (!=) logical operator.

options.name: srcportval
options.description: Port number or range of port numbers to match against the source port number of an outgoing IPv4 packet. In the command line interface, separate the range with a hyphen. For example: 40-90.  Note: The destination port can be specified only for TCP and UDP protocols.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(enabled), the resource will be enabled on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(disabled), the resource will be disabled on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: targettd
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain to which you want to send packet to.

options.name: targettdval
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain to send packet to.

options.name: td
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain in which you want to configure the entity. If you do not specify an ID, the entity becomes part of the default traffic domain, which has an ID of 0.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: ID of the VLAN. The Citrix ADC compares the PBR only to the outgoing packets on the specified VLAN. If you do not specify any interface ID, the appliance compares the PBR to the outgoing packets on all VLANs.

options.name: vxlan
options.description: ID of the VXLAN. The Citrix ADC compares the PBR only to the outgoing packets on the specified VXLAN. If you do not specify any interface ID, the appliance compares the PBR to the outgoing packets on all VXLANs.

options.name: vxlanvlanmap
options.description: The vlan to vxlan mapping to be applied for incoming packets over this pbr tunnel
